title: Suspension Y/T Raise
summary: A bodyweight raise into a Y or T shape on suspension straps, for the rear delts and lower and mid traps.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.8 for rear delts (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly rear delts total.
Library rating 0.8 for traps (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly traps total.
Library rating 0.4 for side delts (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly side delts total.
Library rating 0.4 for upper back (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly upper back total.

setup.text: Hold the handles and lean back with your arms straight in front of you.
Raise your arms out into a Y or a T, pulling your body up.

form_cues.cue: Raise the arms into a Y or T
Keep your arms straight. The lean angle sets the load.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
